bio: Research Overview Research Background Publications Contact Us Dr. Susan Waisbren's research interests include long-term outcomes in metabolic and other genetic disorders. She has conducted studies in newborn screening outcomes and parental response to expanded newborn screening, investigating the impact of true and false positive identifications in terms of parental stress and utilization of healthcare resources.
